name: Buttressed Bellyswell
description: With each breath qi seeps down the arms, keeping the grip firm against blows that would tear it loose.

name: Raw Clout
description: Drawing a full breath, the student lifts the club high and lets it fall as the breath leaves.

name: Rugged Roundhead
description: The hips snap round first and the club follows, bashing into the opponent's near side.

name: Slinking Handholdgrip
description: On the balls of the feet the student angles back and aside, leaving a swing to cut empty air.

name: Sturdy Knob
description: The flat of the shaft slaps an arriving weapon wide before it can find the body.

name: Burlthwack
description: A short reverse stroke raps the club's butt into the opponent's elbow as he withdraws.

name: Brisk Thickend
description: Qi pours into the club's head at the top of the lift, and the slam lands far heavier than the wood alone.

name: Burl Carapace
description: Holding breath and qi still, the student leans the club's shaft against the opponent's chest and pins his movement.

name: Guarding Girth
description: Elbows and knees bent and the club lifted, the student protects his own joints while watching the foe's.

name: Rude Belabor
description: A flick of the club's end cracks the knuckles of the hand that grips a weapon.

name: Binding Bulge
description: A stamp onto the instep pins the opponent's foot, and a knock to the chest topples him.

name: Bludgeon Zip
description: A small hop backward restores the proper distance after a blow has been traded.

name: Thump Scorer
description: Qi gathers at the club's tip and the blow lands on the outside of the elbow, jarring the whole arm.

name: Heartwood Slap
description: A downward drive with qi behind it strikes the front of the knee, making the leg fold under him.

name: Shielding Roundhead
description: The cudgel hangs loose from the grip and sways, ready to swing to either side to block.

name: Wallop Swat
description: The head dips low beside the knee and rises in a long arc into the groin or belly.

name: Knobthwack
description: Turning the wrist at the end of a swing, the student sends the head back along its own path.

name: Clouthurdle
description: The back foot steps opposite the swing so the body balances the cudgel's moving weight.

name: Stoutbarrier
description: The student stops the cudgel's swing against an incoming blow, then lets it run on.

name: Gagging Stout
description: The cudgel's head swings into the bend of the knee and tugs the leg out from under him.

name: Brisk Bellyswell
description: Qi flows down the shaft through the whole swing, so the end of the arc strikes with doubled bite.

name: Knob Prop
description: The head circles in front of the body, knocking away each blade or fist that reaches in.

name: Stern Stout
description: Several swings are strung together without release, then qi flashes through the head in one crushing blow.

name: Thickend Hasp
description: Knees springy and the club held loose, the student is ready to rebound from any contact.

name: Brassthump
description: The club strikes and springs back at once, rapping a second time before the foe recovers.

name: Poisestout
description: A slight angle of the haft makes an incoming blow glance away and the club bounce clear.

name: Rill Cudgel
description: The student tucks low and springs aside, changing direction between one stroke and the next.

name: Brawnburl
description: Off the opponent's parry the club bounds back and knocks hard against the head or neck.

name: Clay Thump
description: Qi snaps the club off a hard surface or guard, and it ricochets into a new target.

name: Hum Girth
description: A qi-hardened parry throws a weapon back along its path and the club returns the blow.

name: Dense Heartwood
description: Chin down and shoulder forward, the student keeps the club ready to slip past a point.

name: Rude Bludgeon
description: A sharp rap on the spear's shaft knocks its point off line.

name: Wallopprop
description: The club slides along the enemy's pole to the knuckles and shoves the grip loose.

name: Fierce Wallop
description: Lunging in beneath the point, the student clouts the opponent's near hand or shoulder.

name: Ruthless Handholdgrip
description: A short knock on the hand-guard of a hafted weapon numbs the fingers behind it.

name: Girthcurl
description: Stepping off the line at a slant, the student gets inside the weapon's reach unharmed.

name: Stouthasp
description: The club bears down on the enemy's pole, and the point is held to the ground.

name: Burl Screen
description: Qi locks the club against the enemy's shaft so that neither can be pulled free.

name: Savage Cudgel
description: Past the point and inside, a qi-driven hammer blow lands on the weapon-arm's shoulder.

name: Bulge Hurdle
description: Qi quickens the legs for one rush that crosses a spear's length before it can be reset.

name: Sprigknob
description: The hand cups the knot of the club as a guard while the other holds the haft.

name: Brassstout
description: The knotted, uneven head smashes down and its ridges tear at skin as well as bruise.

name: Wallopslap
description: The knot's rounded tip jabs hard into the soft hollow of the throat or belly.

name: Hum Bellyswell
description: A twist of the club's knot against an incoming weapon turns it away from the body.

name: Claygirth
description: Planting one foot, the student pivots round it to face an attack from the flank.

name: Gall Clout
description: The knot hooks a belt or strap and drags the opponent forward off his feet.

name: Clay Belabor
description: Qi pooled in the knot makes it land with the force of a mallet.

name: Bulgebuckle
description: Raked backward by qi-hardened ridges, the knot strips a shield or weapon from the opponent's hand.

name: Unmoving Handholdgrip
description: The free hand is held out flat before the face as the club waits low behind it.

name: Grim Bludgeon
description: A palm thrust draws the guard up, and the cudgel strikes the ribs it uncovers.

name: Bulgescreen
description: The free hand seizes a sleeve and tugs the opponent into the cudgel's path.

name: Wallopswerve
description: The cudgel is tucked under the arm so both hands are free as the student closes distance.

name: Acrid Heartwood
description: The cudgel passes from one hand to the other mid-stroke and strikes from the unexpected side.

name: Roundhead Scorer
description: A heel-of-the-palm shove under the ribs bends the opponent over for the club.

name: Gripping Bulge
description: Palm and cudgel close on an arm from both sides, and qi holds it fast.

name: Brisk Cudgel
description: With the cudgel held out of the way, a backhand palm releases a burst of qi into the chest.

name: Clutching Knob
description: A sleeve is twisted and held while the haft flings the opponent sideways into the ground.

name: Stalwart Girth
description: Legs braced wide and the club held across the front, the student endures a rocking blow without moving.

name: Acrid Thump
description: A flat, hard blow to the chest halts the foe's advance.

name: Gallstout
description: A light tap below the knee as the foe steps makes him lurch.

name: Brawn Stout
description: A half-step back and the club level again, so the student regains balance after a heavy swing.

name: Savage Burl
description: An overhand blow charged with qi sends a deep shock through the body that rocks him back.

name: Weighty Thickend
description: While the foe reels, the club leans against his sternum and keeps him from planting his feet.

name: Stalwart Bulge
description: Standing patient and half-turned, the student offers a narrow target and a ready club.

name: Rough Wallop
description: A swinging blow to the great muscle of the thigh slows every step after it.

name: Bludgeon Slap
description: Repeated blows to the upper arm tire the muscle that holds up a weapon.

name: Burlhasp
description: A hip drives into the opponent's hip and breaks his stance before the club swings.

name: Knobhasp
description: Leaning into a block, the student sends the club straight back along the same line.

name: Belabor Zip
description: A swift pivot on the lead foot turns the student away from a rush and out of range.

name: Cruel Heartwood
description: A rap to the ribs makes him turn, and a second rap lands across his back.

name: Stout Slap
description: Qi carried deep into the muscle by the club's weight leaves a bruise that spreads and stiffens.

name: Girthscreen
description: A qi-backed thump to a muscle's belly makes it seize and the limb go stiff.

name: Thumpswat
description: A string of blows is delivered off the opponent's rhythm so each one lands before he can block.
